# PDF Peeps

> PDF Peeps is a free, web-based suite of PDF processing tools. It allows users to convert, merge, split, compress, and edit PDF documents directly within their web browser securely without client-side data exposure.

## Core Utilities
- [PDF Peeps Homepage](https://pdfpeeps.framer.website): Main dashboard access for all PDF web tools and file operations.
- [Merge PDF](https://pdfpeeps.framer.website): Combine multiple PDF documents into a single unified file.
- [Compress PDF](https://pdfpeeps.framer.website): Reduce PDF file sizes while maintaining document clarity and image resolution.
- [Convert PDF](https://pdfpeeps.framer.website): Convert PDF files to and from images (JPG, PNG) or Office formats (Word, Excel).
- [Edit PDF](https://pdfpeeps.framer.website): Fill out forms, insert digital signatures, and annotate PDF pages online.

## Key Capabilities
- **Browser-Based Execution**: All document processing operates locally or in transient secure sessions.
- **Cross-Platform**: Fully compatible with desktop and mobile web browsers without software installation.
- **Zero Cost**: Instant access to core PDF manipulation features without subscription barriers.

## Optional
- [Privacy Policy](https://pdfpeeps.framer.website): Information on security practices, cookie usage, and document handling policies.
- [Contact & Support](https://pdfpeeps.framer.website): Submit feedback or request custom PDF utility features.
